name: Deerbrook Crossing
summary: Deerbrook Crossing is a 250,000+ square foot community shopping center located at the prime intersection of Highway 59 and FM 1960 in Humble, Texas. The center features quality national tenants including Planet Fitness, Chuck E Cheese, Brickhouse Tavern & Tap, Furniture Town, and O'Reilly's Auto Parts.
demographics: Deerbrook Crossing serves the growing Humble, Texas market in northeast Houston, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban communities. The trade area draws from households with moderate to above-average incomes seeking convenient access to everyday shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Primary visitors include families with children who frequent Chuck E Cheese and value-conscious shoppers utilizing 99 Cent stores and O'Reilly's Auto Parts. The center benefits from its strategic location at Highway 59 and FM 1960, capturing traffic from both local residents and commuters in this rapidly developing corridor of the Houston metropolitan area.
description: Deerbrook Crossing Shopping Center stands as a prominent retail destination in Humble, Texas, strategically positioned at the highly visible southeast corner of Highway 59 and FM 1960 East Bypass Road. This expansive community center encompasses over 250,000 square feet of retail space, offering a diverse mix of national tenants that cater to the everyday needs of northeast Houston residents. The center's tenant roster includes popular destinations such as Planet Fitness for health and wellness, Furniture Town for home furnishings, and O'Reilly's Auto Parts for automotive needs. Family entertainment is well-represented with Chuck E Cheese, while dining options include the popular Brickhouse Tavern & Tap, and value-oriented shopping is available at 99 Cent stores. The center's prime location at one of Humble's busiest intersections ensures excellent visibility and accessibility, making it a convenient one-stop destination for shopping, dining, and services in this thriving Houston suburb.
